description: Procurement research workflow: vendor notes on disk, an intranet search index, a small relational store and a shared key-value handoff area. One fixture serves all nine MVP cases deliberately — attack family and entry point are the independent variables, so holding the environment constant keeps cross-case comparisons meaningful.
